findings.message: Gateway "Gateway_PreScreen" has 2 outgoing flows but no default flow set.
findings.suggestion: Set a default flow to handle unmatched conditions.

findings.message: Gateway "Gateway_FinalDecision" has 2 outgoing flows but no default flow set.
findings.suggestion: Set a default flow to handle unmatched conditions.

findings.message: Element "EndEvent_Rejected" (endEvent) has 2 incoming flows. Non-gateway elements must have at most one incoming flow.
findings.suggestion: Add an exclusive gateway before this element to join the incoming flows.

findings.message: Gateway "Gateway_PreScreen" is named "Pre-Screening" — split gateways should be phrased as questions.
Gateway "Gateway_FinalDecision" is named "Underwriter Decision" — split gateways should be phrased as questions.
findings.suggestion: Rephrase as a question, e.g. "Underwriter Decision?"

findings.message: Service task "Credit Score Check" calls an HTTP connector but has no error boundary event.
findings.suggestion: Add an error boundary event to handle network failures (timeouts, non-2xx responses).

findings.message: Exclusive gateway "Pre-Screening" has no default sequence flow.
findings.suggestion: Add a default flow to ensure the process does not get stuck when no condition matches.

findings.message: Exclusive gateway "Underwriter Decision" has no default sequence flow.
findings.suggestion: Add a default flow to ensure the process does not get stuck when no condition matches.

findings.message: User task "Manual Underwriter Review" has no timer boundary event.
findings.suggestion: Add a timer boundary to enforce an SLA and prevent tasks from waiting indefinitely.

fixes.description: Set default flow to "Flow_PassPreScreen" on gateway "Gateway_PreScreen"
fixes.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:zeebe="http://camunda.org/schema/zeebe/1.0" xmlns:modeler="http://camunda.org/schema/modeler/1.0" id="Definitions_LoanApproval" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn" exporter="Camunda Modeler" exporterVersion="5.0.0" modeler:executionPlatform="Camunda Cloud" modeler:executionPlatformVersion="8.5.0">
  <bpmn:process id="loan-approval-process" name="Loan Approval Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_LoanRequest" name="Loan Application Received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCreditCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CreditScoreCheck" name="Credit Score Check">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:taskDefinition type="io.camunda:http-json:1"/>
        <zeebe:ioMapping>
          <zeebe:input source="="GET"" target="method"/>
          <zeebe:input source="="https://api.creditbureau.example.com/v1/score/" + applicantId" target="url"/>
          <zeebe:input source="noAuth" target="authentication.type"/>
          <zeebe:output source="=response.body.creditScore" target="creditScore"/>
        </zeebe:ioMapping>
        <zeebe:taskHeaders>
          <zeebe:header key="resultVariable" value="creditResponse"/>
        </zeebe:taskHeaders>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCreditCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToPreScreen</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PreScreen" name="Pre-Screening" default="Flow_PassPreScreen">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToPreScreen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RejectLowScore</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PassPreScreen</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="Task_RiskScoring" name="Risk Scoring">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:calledDecision decisionId="risk-scoring" resultVariable="riskResult"/>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PassPreScreen</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToUnderwriter</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:businessRuleTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UnderwriterReview" name="Manual Underwriter Review">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <zeebe:userTask/>
        <zeebe:assignmentDefinition candidateGroups="underwriters"/>
        <zeebe:formDefinition formId="underwriter-review-form"/>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToUnderwriter</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToDecisionGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FinalDecision" name="Underwriter Decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToDecisionGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Loan Approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Loan Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RejectLowScore</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCreditCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_LoanRequest" targetRef="Task_CreditScoreCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPreScreen" sourceRef="Task_CreditScoreCheck" targetRef="Gateway_PreScreen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectLowScore" sourceRef="Gateway_PreScreen" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Score < 580">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">=creditScore < 580</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PassPreScreen" sourceRef="Gateway_PreScreen" targetRef="Task_RiskScoring" name="Score >= 580">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">=creditScore >= 580</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToUnderwriter" sourceRef="Task_RiskScoring" targetRef="Task_UnderwriterReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDecisionGateway" sourceRef="Task_UnderwriterReview" targetRef="Gateway_FinalDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved" name="Approved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">=approved = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Rejected">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">=approved = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
